page.content:
Lame smith who forges the gods' weapons and Achilles' shield.

How Hephaestus connects

  • Character: Achilles — Hephaestus forges the shield and armor Achilles wears back to battle.
  • Character: Pandora — Hephaestus fashioned Pandora from earth.
  • Character: Zeus — Hephaestus smiths the thunderbolts Zeus hurls.

What is Hephaestus?

Hephaestus is the craftsman of Olympus, thrown from the mountain and returned as the maker of thunderbolts, automata, and the armor Thetis begs for Achilles.

Key threads lead to Achilles, Pandora and Zeus.
